## Summary


**What this article covers:** A full review of the Tile Slim Bluetooth tracker, including specs, features, where it works best, and how it compares to other Tile trackers.


### Who It’s For


-


Anyone who regularly misplaces their wallet, passport, or other flat valuables


-


Families keeping track of shared items across iOS and Android devices


-


People researching Tile trackers before buying


-


Anyone comparing the Tile Slim to the Tile Mate, Tile Pro, or Tile Sticker

-


The Tile Slim is a credit-card-sized Bluetooth tracker designed to slip into a wallet, passport holder, luggage tag, or similar.


-


At just 2.5mm thick, it's one of the slenderest members of the Tile family.


-


It has a Bluetooth range of up to 350 feet and a 3-year non-replaceable battery.


-


You activate and manage your Tile Slim through the Life360 app, available free for iOS and Android.


-


A QR code on the back helps strangers return your lost item, even if they don't have the app installed.


-


Your Tile Slim appears on the same Life360 map as your family members and other tracked items.


Tile Bluetooth trackers are available in a wide range of sizes and shapes, and the[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) is one of the most popular options for use as a[laptop finder](https://www.life360.com/blog/laptop-finder-app?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) ,[passport finder](https://www.life360.com/blog/find-my-lost-passport?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) , and so much more. This discreet[Bluetooth tracker](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) slips into even the thinnest places thanks to its credit card-like design. Read on to learn everything about everyone's favorite thin, flat tracker.


#### Your wallet deserves a spot on the map too.


The Tile Slim slips into your wallet or passport holder and shows up right alongside your family on the same Life360 map.

## Everything You Need To Know About Tile Slim


A super-sleek, thin tracker designed for flat, narrow spaces, the[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) is the slenderest member of the Tile family, with a thickness of just 2.5mm. Thanks to its unique form factor, this Bluetooth tracker can easily slip inside[wallets](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) ,[passport holders](https://www.life360.com/blog/find-my-lost-passport?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) ,[laptop and tablet cases](https://www.life360.com/blog/laptop-finder-app?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) , and more. Here's what it has to offer:


-


**Design:** A very slim Bluetooth tracker with a credit card shape, available in Black, Navy Blaze, Pink Punch, Aqua Lemon, Green Surf, Blush, Dune, Seaglass, Slate, and limited edition designs and colors.


-


**Dimensions:** 3.37in x 2.13in x 0.09in


-


**Weight:** 14g


-


**Volume:** 104dB+


-


**Range:** Up to 350 feet


-


**Battery:** A[3-year non-replaceable battery](https://www.life360.com/blog/replace-tile-slim-battery?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) is included


-


**Water resistance:** IP68 rated, water resistant up to 5 feet/1.5 meters


-


**Compatibility:** Compatible with both Android™ and Apple® devices


You can buy the[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) individually or in[combo packs](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) to use with different items or share with friends and family. The latest version features a QR code printed on the back that can be scanned[if your Tile gets lost](https://www.life360.com/blog/tile-lost-and-found-contact-owner-scan-code?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) and someone finds it, helping you get it back even if they don't have the app installed. It also has a loud, clear ring so you can hear it easily, making it one of the most reliable and easy-to-use Tile trackers on the market.


In terms of features and functionality, the[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) works just like any other Tile device. Attach it to your wallet, laptop case, or[luggage tag](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) , activate it in the Life360 app for iOS or Android, and from then on, you can ring it and find your missing items with ease. Your wallet, passport, or laptop bag shows up right alongside your family and everything else you're keeping tabs on, all on one map.


## How And Where To Use The Tile Slim Bluetooth Tracker


Thanks to its sleek form factor, there are plenty of ways to put the[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) to work. It can be everything from a wallet finder to a tablet tracker. Here are just a few examples of situations where the Slim is useful:


-


**Wallets:** One of the best uses for the[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) is slipping it inside your[wallet](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) or purse. You'll never have to spend your morning tearing the house apart looking for it again, and your cards and cash stay protected with 350 feet of Bluetooth range backing you up.


-


**Passports:** The[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) also makes an excellent[passport finder](https://www.life360.com/blog/find-my-lost-passport?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) . If you're heading to the airport or prepping for a trip, tuck the Slim inside your passport holder or travel pouch. Ring it through the Life360 app, and you'll have your passport located in seconds.


-


**Pockets:** The Tile Slim fits in coats, jackets, pants pockets, and even bags or backpacks. It's lightweight enough to forget it's there and responsive enough to find your jacket the moment you can't remember where you left it.


-


**Luggage:** Slip the[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) inside a[luggage tag](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) pouch or a small interior pocket before you check your bag. Even at a busy airport, the Life360 and Tile community network can help update your bag's last known location so you're never completely in the dark.


-


**Electronics:** Use the[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) as a[laptop or tablet finder](https://www.life360.com/blog/laptop-finder-app?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) by slipping it into your device case. It also works attached directly to electronics with a simple adhesive, giving you a way to locate your gear wherever it ends up.


## Tile Slim Battery Life


Three years of battery life on a non-replaceable cell means you slip the Tile Slim into your wallet and essentially forget about it. You don’t have to worry about charging it or swapping out batteries. The Slim's credit-card form factor doesn't leave room for a battery door, so the three-year built-in cell keeps the tracker thin enough to fit in the flattest, thinnest places. When the battery eventually runs down, you replace the whole unit.


#### Never check a bag without knowing where it is.


Tuck a Tile Slim into your luggage before you fly, and the Life360 community network helps update its location if it travels out of range.


[See Tile for travel](https://life360.onelink.me/JqZQ?af_web_dp=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.life360.com%2Ftile-trackers&pid=web&c=blog_tile-slim-review&deep_link_value=open)


## Bluetooth Range And The Tile Network


With up to 350 feet of Bluetooth range, the Tile Slim gives you a wide search radius for nearby items. Ring your wallet from anywhere in the house, across a parking lot, or from the other side of a hotel lobby, and the alarm will sound.


When your wallet travels further than that, the Life360 app shows its last known location on a map. While the Tile Slim doesn't have GPS to tap into satellite signals the way a dedicated GPS tracker can, it can update its location whenever it comes within range of another Life360 app user's phone. This is how the Tile community works. The network quietly runs in the background across millions of devices, so if your wallet ends up somewhere out of your immediate range, there's a good chance another user's phone will pick it up and update your map.


## How the Life360 App Works With Your Tile Slim


You activate your Tile Slim in the Life360 app, and that's where everything lives. Ring it from your phone whenever you need it, check its last known location on the map when it's out of range, and tap into the community network to track it down if it's gone further.


A Life360 logo on the tracker's button doubles as a two-way finder. Press it twice, and your phone rings even if it's on silent. That's a useful feature for the reverse scenario, when you have your wallet but have no idea where your phone ended up.


The 2024 update added a triple-press SOS option that sends an alert to your Life360 contacts, available exclusively in the Life360 app. You do have to choose between the two-way find and the SOS alert, since the button can only be set to one or the other at a time. The reverse ring works better for most everyday use, but the SOS function is a nice addition for solo travelers or anyone who wants that extra layer of connection to their Circle.


Add your Tile Slim to the Life360 app, and it shows up on the same map as your family members and everything else you're tracking. One place and view without jumping between apps for the things that matter most.


## How the Tile Slim Compares to Other Tile Trackers


The Tile family includes four trackers, each built for a different kind of item:


1.


**The**[Tile Mate](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-mate?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) is the everyday keychain tracker, a compact square with a loop for keys, bags, or backpacks. It shares similar range and battery life with the Slim, but the form factor is built for attachment.


2.


**The**[Tile Pro](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-pro?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) is the performance pick, with a longer range, a louder alarm, a metal build, and a user-replaceable battery. If maximum volume and durability are the priority, the Pro is the one.


3.


**The**[Tile Sticker](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-sticker?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) is the smallest option. It’s a round tracker with adhesive backing for surfaces without a pocket or slot. Remotes, helmets, and instrument cases are natural fits.


4.


**The Tile Slim** is the only tracker in the family designed specifically for flat, narrow spaces. If your problem is your wallet, passport, or laptop sleeve, the Slim is the one that fits.


## Life360 Membership and Smart Alerts


Tracking your stuff with Tile is included across all[Life360 plans](https://www.life360.com/plans-pricing?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) , starting with the free tier. Smart Alerts are the most useful upgrade for anyone who regularly walks out without their wallet. If that's not a recurring problem, the free Life360 plan handles everything you need for Tile tracking.

The[Tile Slim](https://www.life360.com/tile-trackers/products/tile-slim?icid=blog_tile-slim-thin-bluetooth-tracker-for-flat-surfaces-devices) is the go-to Bluetooth tracker for wallets, passports, luggage tags, and anything else where thin matters more than bulky. The credit-card form factor, three-year battery, IP68 water resistance, and 350-foot Bluetooth range make it a practical, set-it-and-forget-it solution for keeping track of the things you really can't afford to lose.


It activates in the Life360 app on both iOS and Android, offers a QR code recovery option in addition to active tracking, and appears on the same map as your family. Pick it up individually or grab a combo pack to cover your wallet, passport, and laptop case all at once.

### Frequently Asked Questions


**Can I replace the battery in a Tile Slim?** No. The Tile Slim uses a sealed, non-replaceable battery built to last about 3 years. Its credit-card form factor is too thin to fit a battery door, which is part of what keeps it slim enough to slide into a wallet or passport holder. When the battery eventually runs out, you’ll need to replace the whole unit rather than swap in a new cell.


**Does the Tile Slim work without a Bluetooth connection?** Not in real time. The Tile Slim relies on Bluetooth to ring and show its live location when it’s within range of your phone, up to about 350 feet. Outside that range, it depends on the Life360 and Tile community network to update its last known location whenever another user’s phone passes nearby. It doesn’t have GPS, so it can’t report a live location the way a dedicated GPS tracker can.


**What’s the difference between the Tile Slim and the Tile Sticker?** Both are compact and built for items without a loop or clip, but they’re designed for different shapes. The Tile Slim is flat and credit-card shaped, built specifically for wallets, passports, and laptop sleeves. The Tile Sticker is small and round with an adhesive back, better suited for curved or irregular surfaces like remotes, helmets, or instrument cases.


**Can someone find and return my Tile Slim if they don’t have the Life360 app?** Yes. The Tile Slim includes a QR code on the back that anyone can scan with a phone camera, no app required, which helps connect a finder back to you even if they’ve never used Life360 or Tile. This works alongside the active Bluetooth tracking, giving you two separate ways for a lost item to find its way back.


**Do I need a paid Life360 plan to use the Tile Slim?** No. Basic Tile tracking, including ringing your Tile Slim and seeing its last known location, is included on Life360’s free plan. Upgrading to a paid plan unlocks Smart Alerts, which notify you if you’ve left an item behind, plus location history and features like emergency dispatch and roadside assistance for the rest of the family.
